about: Modwerk source-only MIDI Feedback package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74.

mods.title: MIDI Feedback
mods.summary: Automatic feedback for seven parameters per drum track, for controller pickup.
mods.description: Sends settled parameter values and periodic refreshes over DIN MIDI OUT for controller pickup.
mods.author: claptom-music
mods.on_unit: Author tested MF06 on OS 1.74 with a PC12. See the MF06 report for results and the unresolved earlier freeze.
